py-01-c3.text: Python Software Foundation (2026). The Python Language Reference: Compound statements (Function definitions). Python 3 documentation (docs.python.org).
py-01-c3.quote: This means that the expression is evaluated once, when the function is defined, and that the same "pre-computed" value is used for each call.
py-01-c3.claim: A parameter's default value is evaluated once, when the function is defined, not on each call.
